WITH pruned AS (
    SELECT memory.id,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT jsonb_object_agg(atom.key, atom.value)
            FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(memory.evidence->'protected_atoms') = 'object'
                THEN memory.evidence->'protected_atoms' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) AS atom
            WHERE EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(memory.target_inline) AS node
                WHERE node->>'type' = 'protected_ref' AND node->>'ref' = atom.key
            )
        ), '{}'::jsonb) AS atoms
    FROM translation_memory AS memory
    WHERE memory.evidence ? 'protected_atoms'
)
UPDATE translation_memory AS memory
SET evidence = jsonb_set(memory.evidence, '{protected_atoms}', pruned.atoms),
    generation = memory.generation + 1
FROM pruned
WHERE memory.id = pruned.id
    AND memory.evidence->'protected_atoms' IS DISTINCT FROM pruned.atoms
